entries.title: Slopes
entries.reason: Completed shared slopes, art and editor persistence; closed with local implementation evidence and broader release gates disclosed.

closure.body:
Implemented locally on `1.2.1`: all five coloured slopes have four quarter-turn orientations, shared triangle collision, and player support for walking up and down without jumping. Editor placement, rotation and persistence, block-style art and supported walking animation are included.

Current native integration covers all 20 colour/orientation combinations; 32 current red-slope runtime cases pass. Broader actor, multiplayer and frame-cap regression remains on the release checklist.

Closing the implemented feature scope. These changes have not yet been committed, pushed or released.

entries.title: Code Refactor with how the game loads levels from files
entries.reason: Completed shared level-document implementation and compatibility fixtures; closed with local evidence and live Workshop gate disclosed.

closure.body:
Implemented locally on `1.2.1`: editor, packaged challenges and Workshop levels now use the same global level-document reader, validator and instance-application implementation. Existing entrypoints are context adapters. New-format saves, legacy compatibility, metadata and ordered instance creation share that implementation.

Native integration fixtures pass for legacy/new round trips, malformed-load preservation, metadata/order and the 4,636-instance Lunar document. Actual Steam Workshop service interactions remain part of release testing.

Closing the implemented refactor scope. These changes have not yet been committed, pushed or released.

entries.title: Controller Customization
entries.reason: Completed all sixteen-button/six-action remapping including Start, unused Pause routing and actual saved mapping transactions; current native completion independently checked, physical-input release gates disclosed.

closure.body:
Implemented locally on `1.2.1`: all six gameplay actions can be assigned any of the sixteen standard controller buttons, including Start. Capture/cancel/reset, selected-device polling and persistence use the shared mapping implementation. Pause chooses an unused button when needed, and controls/pause prompts display it.

Current native validation completes all 16 × 6 assignment assertions and actual settings save/load with Start bound to Jump and Back bound to Skip. Independent read-only review confirms the normal engine completion, isolated test saves and an unchanged production profile. Physical controllers, hotplug and mobile-device input remain release checks.

Closing the requested customization scope. These changes have not yet been committed, pushed or released.

entries.title: Code Refactor for Settings
entries.reason: All four original settings checklist items implemented and checked; closed with local evidence and hardware gates disclosed.

closure.body:
Implemented locally on `1.2.1`: settings use shared data-driven definitions, code-created and code-drawn buttons, Boolean and partial (`~`) indicators, and common music/sound/master-volume sliders. Main settings and the pause overlay use the same settings spawner and cleanup paths.

Current Check26 native settings validation and persistence fixtures pass. Physical controller/touch checks remain part of the platform release testing.

All four checklist items are complete. These changes have not yet been committed, pushed or released.

entries.title: Enemy Troop Code-Refactor
entries.reason: Completed shared navigation/lifecycle refactor and W5-L4 route checks; closed with local evidence and Lunar route gate disclosed.

closure.body:
Implemented locally on `1.2.1`: troop navigation geometry is shared and cached, path requests are staggered and bounded, geometry changes invalidate the cache, and defeat rewards are separated from ordinary cleanup. Movement/reaction guards and activation-region dimensions are repaired.

Current ordinary W5-L4 replays complete 18/18 runs across 60, 75, 100, 120, 144 and 150 render caps, with zero deaths and no gun/ammo use. Current native integration also passes 35 navigation comparisons covering 26,880 cells. Other encounters, including Lunar Base's full route, remain on the release checklist.

Closing the implemented refactor scope. These changes have not yet been committed, pushed or released.
